transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Daniel. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Daniel, I'm Sneha Patel. My internet connection has been dropping every ten minutes for the last three days. It's absolutely infuriating!
Agent: I am so sorry to hear that you've been dealing with these constant drops, Sneha. I know how frustrating it is when your connection is unstable.
Customer: It's making it impossible to work from home. I'm using phone number 92211 71715 and I can't get a stable signal at all.
Agent: Let me check the network status in your area. One moment please.
Customer: I've already restarted the router three times today alone.
Agent: I see a local outage affecting several houses on your street. It looks like a network fault in the local cabinet.
Customer: Why is this happening? I'm paying for a high-speed plan and I'm not getting it.
Agent: I understand. By the way, I noticed a double charge on your last bill. Trust me, the money will definitely be back in your account by tomorrow.
Customer: Oh, I hadn't even noticed that. Thank you for pointing it out.
Agent: I will now raise a network ticket to prioritize the repair of that cabinet for your address.
Customer: That sounds great. Will I be back online soon?
Agent: Yes, the engineers are already working on it and the ticket will speed up the process. You should be stable within a few hours.
Customer: I'm very relieved. Thank you so much for your help, Daniel.
Agent: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've raised the network ticket and the refund is processing. Goodbye!
